module: Node "AI Flee" (color ai, once_p_duration). Puts a vehicle in "flee" AI mode to flee from another vehicle. Inputs: aiVehId (no value = player vehicle), targetId (defaults to the player vehicle).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

workOnce.desc: Sends ai.setMode("flee") then ai.setTargetObjectID(targetId) to the vehicle.
